findings.summary: I24 only authorized SES production access request submission, not Lambda deploy, IAM/env mutation, production credential mutation, or reset email sending.
AWS accepted the request and SES account review status is PENDING; password-reset execute remains blocked until ProductionAccessEnabled=true or all target recipients are verified.

recommendation: Poll SES account status before rerunning password reset remediation execute. Do not send reset emails while ProductionAccessEnabled=false unless all target recipients are separately verified SES identities.
